title: A Problem to Warm Up the Eyebrows
statement: The task sums (-1)^(a+b)·S^2 over all submatrices of an n×m integer table (a rows, b columns, element sum S) modulo 10^9+7, with n·m up to 10^6, so only O(nm) fits. Writing S as four 2D prefix-sum corners makes the sign factor over corner parities, and expanding the squares collapses each dimension to (Σw)(Σwx²)−(Σwx)²; equivalently, a row sweep tracks signed count, sum and sum-of-squares moments.
